title: SeededRandom must be PCG32 per GDD §13 (currently wraps System.Random) — replay/determinism prerequisite
description: Found during the TASK-025 review: Core's SeededRandom wraps System.Random rather than implementing PCG32, which GDD §13 mandates ('Generador: PCG32... Prohibido System.Random y UnityEngine.Random en Barcade.Core'). System.Random's algorithm is not guaranteed stable across .NET versions, which undermines the §13/D.4 replay guarantee (same seed + inputs => bit-identical session, finalStateHash equality across binary updates on the same contentVersion) and the CI analyzer rule the GDD asks for. Replace the internals of SeededRandom with a proper PCG32 implementation while PRESERVING the public API (NextFloat/NextInt/etc.) so all consumers keep compiling — but note this CHANGES the value sequences for every seed, so any test pinning specific seed-derived values must be updated in the same change (expected churn, do it once, before more mechanics pin more seeds — the longer this waits the more expensive it gets). Add the §13 stream-derivation helpers if absent (sessionSeed -> roundSeed(r) -> per-subsystem streams) since T-108/T-113 will need them. Also add the static-analyzer/CI grep rule §13 requires (no System.Random / UnityEngine.Random in Core). GDD-canonical decision applies. Blocks the fidelity of TASK-032 (.bcrp replay) — that ticket should treat this as a de-facto dependency (comment added there).
acceptance_criteria: SeededRandom is a genuine PCG32 (reference vectors from the PCG paper/site verified by test), public API preserved, all consumers compile unchanged
Seed-pinning tests across the suite updated in the same change; full fast suite green
Stream derivation per GDD 13 exists: sessionSeed -> roundSeed(r) -> named per-subsystem streams, with independence pinned by test (consuming from one stream does not shift another)
A CI/analyzer check fails the build if System.Random or UnityEngine.Random is referenced inside Barcade.Core
Determinism: same seed => same sequence across two process runs (test), documenting the platform scope per GDD 13

comments.body: [RE-APPLIED after working-tree cleaning lost the original write] FULL-depth fresh-context review (rev-c044) of the CLOUD-authored TASK-044 (branch claude/gdd-hito1-cloud, commits 21fe765 test -> 3fb67ac feat), pinned at 3fb67ac: APPROVE-WITH-NITS on its own tree — 0 HIGH, 0 MEDIUM, 2 LOW. Suite 492/492 firsthand; red reproduced (compile-red on the new PCG32 surface); commit order strict; tdd honored. AC1 AUTHENTICITY PROVEN (not calibration laundering): reviewer independently transcribed canonical pcg_basic.c to Python and computed srandom(42,54) -> 0xa15c02b7 0x7b47f409 0xba1d3330 0x83d2f293 0xbfa4784b 0xcbed606e — exact match with the pinned vectors AND the published pcg32-demo Round 1 output; LCG multiplier, inc=(streamId<<1)|1, srandom init dance, XSH-RR permutation all canonical line-for-line. AC4 analyzer MUTATION-TESTED: System.Random probe injected -> test fails; removed -> clean; executable in both runners; fast-tests links Core sources (single source of truth). AC3 independence test genuine (interleaved draws + equality assert; SplitMix64 bijection collision-free). API preserved or strictly improved: NextFloat top-24-bit [0,1) strict (old could round to 1.0f); NextInt keeps System.Random edge contract + gains rejection sampling (uniformity test); ISeededRandom untouched, zero consumer files modified. AC2: exactly one existing test file touched (SequencerTests.cs, two 10-pick sequences recalibrated exactly, nothing weakened). AC5 satisfied-in-substance: externally-computed published constants validated on every run (cross-process by construction), platform scope documented per GDD 13. LOW-1: SeededRandom.cs:110 (uint)(-bound) relies on unchecked default — wrap in unchecked() like line 86 (behavior-preserving, shifts no streams). LOW-2: AC4 says 'CI check' but the repo has NO CI pipeline -> TASK-049 filed. OBS: empty-range NextInt no longer consumes a draw (harmless); PCG same-state stream correlations theoretical only. INTEGRATION: blast radius = SequencerTests.cs + new Pcg32SeededRandomTests (10) + csproj; ALL 17 local-only tests survive — verified statically AND empirically via trial cherry-pick onto local master 45c6259: combined 476/476. No code coupling to cloud TASK-024/035. FOLLOW-UP (concurs with cloud dev note 9): selector Combine() vs this ticket's Derive() dual idiom — folded into the TASK-035 integration fix round. INTEGRATION EXECUTED: picks landed on master as 7b2fc40 (test) / 4d6db74 (feat); unchecked() wrap pending as its own commit; rev-c044 re-verifies.
